description: This source file implements the DuplicatingMessageMapper class, which duplicates incoming messages a configurable number of times, based on a 'n' parameter. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging services.

classes.name: DuplicatingMessageMapper
classes.description: A message mapper that duplicates an incoming message a specified number of times, with configuration for the duplication count.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with a property 'n' that determines how many times to duplicate messages.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage into multiple duplicated messages based on 'n'.

methods.name: map (Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable into multiple duplicated external messages based on 'n'.
